描述_ZN: Lone Pine and High Scholar", Ming Dynasty, painted by Cheng Jiasui, on paper with color, 130.2 cm in length and 31.2 cm in width.　　The picture depicts a tall scholar looking far away from a lone pine, a child with a qin, and a scene of the green hills separated from the river. The clouds are mindlessly out of the mountains, the birds are tired of flying and know how to return. The scene is shaded to enter, and the pine is coiled. This painting is signed: "Painted by Meng Yang at Couple Farming Hall in Yushan in the ninth month of autumn in the fourth year of Chongzhen." Inscription: "Seal of Cheng Jiasui" in white characters. The author was 67 years old in 1631, the fourth year of Chongzhen.　　The composition of this painting is based on Ni Zan's "Two Banks of a River", with emphasis on the lone pine and the gao shi, which highlights the theme of high elegance. The mountains are sparsely chiseled, with the brushwork of the Yuan Dynasty. The figures are serious, with fine and delicate brushwork. The painting is elegantly painted with flowers and blue, the mountains are verdant, and the ancient pines are beautiful.　　The seal of appreciation includes "Sun Yufeng Collection Seal", "Xiyi", "Liu's Hanbi Zhuang Seal", "Xuzhai Seal of Approval", "Susanna Zhai Seal", and "Susanna Zhai Seal", "Susanna Susanna Zhai seal", "temporarily obtained in their own fast and self-sufficient" and other seals.
